scope.purpose: Show how far a task of known size has gone, or that a longer task is under way.
useCases: Upload or import with a known size.
A multi-step process (step 3 of 5 shown as a fraction).
exclusions: Meters (a static value in a range, like disk usage): a separate semantic, later.
alternatives: Spinner for a short wait in a small place.

decisionsTaken: Linear bar only, with a required label shown above it by default (showLabel) and an optional percentage (showValue, tabular figures).

Indicator colors reuse color.status.{intent}.icon (accent, success, warning, danger): these roles already reach 3:1 on surfaces; the contract contrast block measures them against the track (color.surface.muted), surface.default and surface.overlay in 18 contexts: 0 failures.
Component tokens component.progress.thickness.{sm,md,lg} = 4, 6, 8 px (a value meaningful for Progress only).

Indeterminate: a one-third segment sweeping once per motion.duration.loop (new semantic role shared with Skeleton, 1500 ms), three times slower under reduced motion; value changes transition over motion.duration.base.
Corners: component token component.progress.radius, so that a brand can draw rectangular bars (user, 2026-11-03).
nextAction: Delivery with wave 3: pull request of wave/3 to main (user merge); publication needs explicit authorization.
implementationNotes: Bits UI Progress.Root (2.19.3) does not render the id it receives: the component uses its child snippet to place the id on the progress bar itself.
The label stays in the DOM, visually hidden, when showLabel is false, and names the bar through aria-labelledby.
